text: Entry Requirements Applicants must abide by Chinese laws and school regulations, have good moral character and be in good health. The applicant is aged 16-25. Applicant is not a Chinese citizen. Applicants need to graduate from high school or obtain a certificate of graduation from high school. Applicants need to pass HSK Level 4, TOEFL 60 or IELTS 5.5 or Duolingo 90.
